title: Image and alt text
summary: alt provides an image description that can be read by screen reading software. figcaption Displays the legend associated with the image on the page.
tasks: adds alt to the img in the figure, and the text is "Schematic diagram of training building".
Add figcaption after the picture and write "Web Design Training Room".
hint: Keep the existing src on img and write the description in the alt attribute of the same tag. When written as title, the alt attribute is still missing.
goal: Add alternative text to the schematic diagram of the training building and display the legend under the diagram.

example.note: cup.jpg is a picture in the same folder. Alternate text describes the appearance of the pottery cup, and the illustration explains the origin of the work.
